This recipe from AllRecipes matches all the criteria:

This is a popular meat sauce recipe submitted by John Chandler, perfect for lasagna or as a spaghetti sauce.

## 🛒 Shopping List of Ingredients

| # | Ingredient |
|---|------------|
| 1 | 1 pound sweet Italian sausage, sliced |
| 2 | ¾ pound lean ground beef |
| 3 | ½ cup minced onion |
| 4 | 2 cloves garlic, crushed |
| 5 | 1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes |
| 6 | 2 (6.5 ounce) cans tomato sauce |
| 7 | 2 (6 ounce) cans tomato paste |
| 8 | ½ cup water |
| 9 | 2 tablespoons white sugar |
| 10 | 1 ½ teaspoons dried basil |
| 11 | 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning |
| 12 | ½ teaspoon fennel seed |
| 13 | ½ teaspoon salt |
| 14 | ¼ teaspoon ground black pepper |

**Total: 14 ingredients** — all source-verified from the AllRecipes recipe page. The recipe yields 16 servings with 15 minutes prep time and 1 hour 40 minutes cook time.
